lina (devex): FYI hitting a flaky failure in the Node sampleapp when embeddings -> rerank run together. intermittent vector length errors.
omar (sdk): can you paste the stack?
harry (sampleapp): snippet from staging run:
```
Error: InvalidArgument: expected embeddings[0].length == 1536, got 1537
 at parseVectors (/usr/src/app/src/vec.ts:48:15)
 at processBatch (/usr/src/app/src/batcher.ts:102:9)
Caused by: Unexpected key null in rerank request body
```
lina (devex): reproduced locally after hammering auth refresh. looks like retry path re-enqueues the same batch but a shallow concat adds an extra 0 value when merging arrays.
marta (eng-ml): that would explain the +1 dim. separately, our rerank client falls back to `{ items: null }` when scoring panics, which triggers the "Unexpected key null" logs. two small failures colliding.
omar (sdk): action items: 1) fix concat to avoid mutating original arrays (use preallocated buffer or deep copy), 2) add verifyVectors(vec, expectedDim) in client, 3) make rerank envelope strict (reject null items).
harry (sampleapp): quick patch: `if (vec.length !== MODEL_DIMS) throw new Error('vec dim mismatch')` fixes dev repro.
replay-bot: deploy queued: sdk/v0.9.3 -> canary (1 host)
omar (sdk): adding unit test that simulates concurrent token refresh + batch retry; also e2e that mocks a 401 mid-flow and asserts rerank body shape.
marta (eng-ml): can we add a CI smoke that runs the sampleapp flow under `REDWOOD_VEC_STRICT=1` to catch these early?
lina (devex): yes, adding note to onboarding: enable strict shape checking in dev mode. I'll update README and quickstart.
harry (sampleapp): will add migration blurb for teams using the batching helper.
omar (sdk): PR coming shortly, ping me if you see similar flakes. :thumbsup:
lina (devex): thanks everyone, this spared a production customer confusion. keeping this thread for follow-ups.
